concept: One comment, one meeting. The film holds a single speech bubble over the same cartoon meeting room and changes its state part by part: vague and warm, then behaviour, then effect, then one step. The viewer watches the same object get fixed, tries a faded version on a new small scene, then sees the opening frame return changed: next week Sam lets Priya finish.
world: A neutral, recognisable world, not a metaphor: a warm story-cartoon office meeting room (office world pack, Loom.place.meeting) held as the home station, with three short excursions (the viewer's own desk, Dev's video call, a desk calendar). A governing metaphor was tested (comment as a tool, as a recipe) and rejected: the real meeting is safer and fits the skill exactly, because the thing taught is literally a sentence said in that room.
look: story-cartoon (illustrated), classic treatment as the brief asks: outlined cast from designed rigs (sam rig for Sam; Priya, the manager and Dev cast in pass 2 from the kit), paper ground with grain, chat-style bubbles, drop entrances with springy overshoot, cut camera with pushes into the part that matters. Newer treatments are listed under alternatives.

devices.what: THE comment: one chat bubble held as a station whose contents swap in place (swap slot). Vague words in grey, then a part at a time arrives in its own calm tint, the earlier version fading to a ghost behind it. Text lives on this object, never on a bare card.

The same meeting room cutaway (Sam, Priya, the manager, two muted background colleagues) held across the film with its state changed: emptying out, a week later, replayed, and finally next week. Kept slightly muted until the payoff, when it gets full colour.

Three slots that are objects: behaviour, effect, one step, each a fixed tint (behaviour teal-grey, effect sand, step sage). They open at the end of the bubble, lift off as tiles, reappear on answer card B, on the sticky note and beside the presenter's fingers.

Stepped time (illustrated D-114 primitive): a small wall calendar in the meeting room flips one page, 'next week', with the room re-staged in a single step. Used for the failure in the hook and the success in the payoff.
Answer cards with three tick discs (observable, real effect, one step). Ticks drop in on their words; a missing tick stays an empty dashed disc. The faded practice device.

join_material: paper: section boundaries are a page turn of the paper ground (illustrated material join), fallback a hard cut on a black narration card; inside a topic the comment_bubble is the handoff (the bubble carries across the cut), and pushes enter the bubble itself.

value_script.accent: none: the vague bubble in warm cream, no saturated accent
value_script.why: Pale open; the comment looks pleasant and harmless.
Same pale room a week later; the only loud thing is the interruption.
Close on the bubble, slightly richer as we start to look inside it.
Dark break for the key misconception: a judgement closes Sam down; black narration-card ground behind him.
Colour floods back at the turn: the first concrete part of the comment, marigold accent on the words being named.

value_script.accent: the part being added now (effect, then step)
value_script.why: Richer middle; the accent always marks the newest part, the settled parts keep their calm tints.
New small scene for the check; calm and productive so the viewer can think.
The viewer's own desk, quiet, practical.
Lift at the close: colour withheld from the meeting room all film arrives in full; the habit has shifted.

sections.treatment: Story-cartoon scene in the held meeting room, expressive register for the hook, then calm. Drawn cast from rigs, chat bubble as the comment. Entry join: none (open). Camera: cut, one push into the bubble.
sections.accent_on: Priya's cut-off bubble, then the empty hand
sections.world: meeting room, then the viewer's desk

beats.line: Station meeting_room, WIDE establishing, story_role hook. Room emptying; manager's hand on Sam's shoulder; comment_bubble drops in with overshoot over Sam, who grins and nods; Priya gathers notes behind. Something quietly wrong: Priya's notes half-filled. Option: bespoke motion scene (Loom.place.meeting + character rigs). Alternatives: scenario.dialogue.

Same WIDE frame, story_role setup. week_step: wall calendar flips, room re-staged a week later; Sam's hand up mid-sentence, Priya's bubble cut off; the old comment bubble greys beside them. 'Nothing changed' written on the greyed bubble. Option: scenario.dialogue (Sam, Priya) on the meeting backdrop. Alternatives: bespoke continuation of b01.

MEDIUM, story_role orient. Shape morph: cartoon Sam morphs into a viewer silhouette at their own desk, holding the same nice-but-empty bubble. Planned as drawn (upgrade from template: the morph IS the bridge). Option: hero.character_moment. Alternatives: bespoke shape morph.

CLOSE on the bubble (push enters it), story_role refute. Bubble large centre; left a warm glow tagged 'Feels good', right an empty hand reaching and finding nothing to grip, tagged 'Nothing to repeat'. Option: compare.two with drawn halves. Alternatives: bespoke close-up.

Avatar presenter, MEDIUM, story_role transition. Presenter beside the frozen meeting_room plate, gesturing at the bubble as an invitation. Option: avatar over scene plate. Alternatives: avatar on paper ground.

sections.treatment: Comment morph over the replayed meeting scene. Opens on the dark break (label on Sam), then the bubble swaps word by word. Productive register for the demonstration. Entry join: chapter (paper page turn). Camera: push from two-shot into the bubble.
sections.accent_on: the 'Dominating' stamp, then the words 'spoke over Priya'

beats.line: MEDIUM CLOSE on Sam, story_role turn (misconception). 'Dominating' label stamped on Sam's chest, tagged 'Judgement'; arms fold, face tightens, a low wall rises between him and the speaker. Dark ground. Option: hero.character_moment (expression changes on cue). Alternatives: scenario.dialogue.

MEDIUM TWO-SHOT, replayed meeting, story_role demonstrate. Stamp peels off Sam; comment_bubble swaps word by word into 'In that meeting, you spoke over Priya'; the overlap of Sam's bubble on Priya's is what the highlight points at. Behaviour slot fills, tagged 'A behaviour'. Option: bespoke motion (swap slot + rigs). Alternatives: hero.character_moment.
beats.join: continue (hold the station, change its state)

beats.line: CLOSE on the comment (push enters the bubble), story_role check. Rewritten comment holds still; a dashed empty slot after it pulses slowly; tag 'Still missing?'. Planned as drawn (upgrade from template: holds the comment station so the gap is literally the next state). Option: bespoke held bubble. Alternatives: document.page with an empty line.

sections.treatment: Same held bubble over the meeting room; each part fills its slot and the earlier version fades behind. Slowdown section, peak energy, but calm motion: one loud thing at a time. Entry join: continue (same station, within topic). Camera: pull back to the room for the reread.
sections.accent_on: the newest part of the comment
sections.world: meeting room with the held comment

beats.line: MEDIUM, bubble over two-shot, story_role demonstrate. Dashed slot fills with 'Priya could not finish her point' (effect tint, accent while new); in the scene Priya's half bubble hangs with a trailing break; earlier version fades behind. Option: bespoke motion (swap slot). Alternatives: hero.character_moment.

MEDIUM, Sam and the speaker side by side at the table, story_role demonstrate. Third slot opens; a long scrolling to-do list shrinks to one line that slides into the slot, 'One small step', shared between them. Option: bespoke motion. Alternatives: physics priorityJar (list items tipping out to one).

WIDE then CLOSE: complete comment large over the meeting room, the three parts lighting one at a time as read; vague first version a faint ghost behind. story_role consolidate (reread). Option: bespoke motion. Alternatives: skia key-phrase arrival (blur to sharp).
beats.builder: bespoke (held bubble, three slots lit in turn)

beats.line: INSERT, story_role consolidate. The three tinted parts lift off the bubble and line up as tiles: Behaviour, Effect, One step; faint blank tiles of other shapes sit dimly beside them (others exist). Option: recap template. Alternatives: icon.grid.

sections.treatment: Faded practice on a new small scene: Dev on a video call with an empty agenda slot, answer cards below. Productive, calm register. Entry join: chapter (paper page turn). Camera: cut, then push onto a card.
sections.accent_on: the empty agenda slot, then the missing third tick

beats.line: WIDE new scene, story_role practice. Small cartoon of Dev at a call, empty agenda slot on the shared screen; three answer cards drop in one by one as read, none marked. Option: quiz.question with a drawn scene header. Alternatives: scenario.dialogue then quiz.question.

CLOSE on card B, story_role check. Card B lifts forward, its three parts light in the slot tints and three tick discs drop: Observable, Real effect, One step. A and C slide back. Option: quiz.answer. Alternatives: compare.two.

CLOSE on card C, story_role refute. Card C returns with behaviour and effect ticked; 'be more prepared' gets a hand-drawn brush circle; third tick disc stays empty, tagged 'No step'. Option: hybrid, quiz.answer plus brush markup layer. Alternatives: quiz.answer alone.

sections.treatment: The viewer's own desk, then the opening frame back, changed, then the presenter close. Expressive register for the payoff. Entry join: chapter (paper page turn). Camera: insert, then the wide establishing frame from b01.
sections.accent_on: the crossed-out line, then Priya's completed bubble
sections.world: desk calendar, then the meeting room next week

beats.line: INSERT POV, story_role practice (independent). Desk calendar with one sticky note carrying a vague comment; a pen strikes it and the three empty tinted slots appear beneath. Option: document.page styled as the sticky note. Alternatives: bespoke brush markup.

WIDE, the b01 frame back, story_role payoff. Before and after split of the same meeting with the new comment; week_step flips the calendar: next week, Sam waits, hand lowered, while Priya's bubble completes in full; room in full colour for the first time. Option: bespoke motion (place.meeting split + stepped time). Alternatives: compare.two then timeline.

Avatar presenter, MEDIUM, story_role close. Three fingers raised one at a time, each with its tinted slot phrase beside it: What happened, What it caused, One step; calm meeting room plate behind. Option: avatar over scene plate. Alternatives: recap template.

alternatives: Newer treatment (not default, the person chooses): the comment as a paper sticky note rewritten by hand with the brush markup recipe in b07 to b11, instead of a chat bubble swap.
Newer treatment: a skia blur-to-sharp arrival for the complete comment in b11 (one hero light moment).
Classic fallback joins: hard cut on a black narration card at each section boundary instead of the paper page turn.
b10 alternative: physics priorityJar, the long list's items tipping out until one remains.
open_questions: Cast for Priya, the manager and Dev: only the sam rig is named; pass 2 picks rigs from ava, maya, pip, tess, extra and fixes one look per name.
Quiz name: the teaching plan's quiz says Priya starts the call, the script says Dev. The outline follows the script (Dev); not verified with the script author.
Allocation estimate is about 130 s against a 120 s request; b13 (about 18 s) is the long beat. Not resolved here.
Organisation's own feedback model is unknown; b12 keeps 'one useful shape, others exist' visible with blank tiles.
